sloka: मानयन् तम् महात्मानम् यथावत् च अभिअवादयम् ।उक्ताः च न आशिषः तेन संतुष्टेन अन्तरात्मना ॥४-९-२५॥
transliteration: mānayan tam mahātmānam yathāvat ca abhiavādayam ।uktāḥ ca na āśiṣaḥ tena saṁtuṣṭena antarātmanā ॥4-9-25॥

translations.english: 'When my brother came back to the town after killing the enemy, I offered as usual my salutations to him. But he did not bless me wholeheartedly.
